messages:
maria: Heads-up — packaging for private/vpc 1.12.0 is staged on staging-artifact-store. We consolidated the shrinkwrap + delta flow into a single transport bundle to reduce round trips. Planning a transport cutover window at 05:00 UTC tomorrow. Need signoff on: cosign keys, KMS handoff, and the rollback flag matrix.

devon: quick q — did the bundle include the new compact installer variant? the one that strips unused connectors?

maria: yes, compact installer included as `installer-1.12.0-compact.tgz` and full installer `installer-1.12.0.tgz`. Both are in the bundle. We also added an explicit submanifest for offline mirrors (`mirror-seed.json`).

jen: ops note — there's a KMS rotation scheduled in prod at 06:00 UTC (org calendar). If we ship at 05:00 and the transport requires a signer exchange, that could race. Ops-signer, can we delay rotation by 1 hour?

ops-signer: I can shift rotation to 07:00 for this window. Confirm you want the shift and I'll update the runbook.

maria: please shift. We'll also publish a short rollback procedure so we don't need a key rollback.

sam: build verification results? checksums + manifest parity?

deploy-bot: artifact-check: installer-1.12.0.tgz sha256=3a7f8b... OK
deploy-bot: artifact-check: installer-1.12.0-compact.tgz sha256=9c2e1d... OK
deploy-bot: manifest-compare: staging vs shrinkwrap parity ✅

devon: can you paste the cosign verify command here for ops to run during handoff?

maria: sure — ops run:```
cosign verify --key kms://projects/our-project/locations/global/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/cosign-key 
--signature bundle-signature.sig registry.example.com/private/1.12.0
```

jen: rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if: (1) canary fails health check for >120s on >2 hosts, (2) checksum mismatch observed on any mirror, (3) deploy-bot reports signer mismatch. Otherwise, hold open for 15m observation before full rollout. Thoughts?

sam: +1 but add a fourth: if metrics regression (latency p95) spikes >2x baseline during canary, abort.

maria: agreed. I'll add to release notes under 'Delivery & Rollback'. Also adding a canary holdback slot in the transport so we can pause promotions without unpinning.

ops-signer: KMS rotation shifted to 07:00. I updated runbook and created a short checklist: connect to KMS, verify key policy, confirm cosign verify output.

devon: one more: do we need to create a temporary image-pin for the private registry during window? avoids accidental promotion.

maria: yes, we'll pin `registry.private/our-service:1.12.0-transport` for the window and unpin on success. I'll coordinate the unpin within the 15m observation.

deploy-bot: preflight: transport-escort v1 start at 04:30 UTC for artifact staging
deploy-bot: preflight: signer check OK (kms key id matches metadata)

jen: release notes snippet (for the customer-facing doc): "Private/VPC 1.12.0 delivers packaging consolidation to reduce installer transit times. Includes compact installer and mirror-seed for airgap deployments. See private release notes for delivery window and rollback procedures." I'll paste full copy in the docs channel after this thread.

maria: good. last action items: (1) ops-signer confirmed rotation shift, (2) devon will hold image-pin, (3) jen will publish release note snippet, (4) sam will run final parity check at 04:45 UTC. If everyone OK, I'll mark this as green for the window.

jen: +1 :thumbsup:

devon: +1

sam: running parity at 04:45 — will report back

deploy-bot: preflight: all gates passed, awaiting manual GO at 04:55 UTC

maria: GO for 05:00 window from me unless sam raises anything in the next 10m.

sam: parity OK. checksums match, mirror-seed validated. No blocker.

maria: final: proceeding with transport at 05:00 UTC. Will post a short post-mortem if we hit any unexpected issues. Thanks everyone. :party_popper:
